[阅读A] Liu Fang works in a small bookshop. She noticed that many children came in but few bought books. So she started a "reading corner" with cushions and a small lamp. Children could sit and read for free. At first, some parents worried that the children would only play. But after a month, sales of children's books had doubled. "If a child falls in love with reading here," Liu Fang says, "they will come back for the rest of their life." What happened after Liu Fang started the reading corner?（2分）
A．Fewer children came in.
B．Sales of children's books doubled.
C．Parents stopped buying books.
D．The shop closed.
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 A。What happened after Liu Fang started the reading corner? 对应原文信息点。

question:
[阅读B] The number of electric cars in Chinese cities has grown quickly. They produce no exhaust gas, which helps improve air quality. But electric cars also bring new problems. Charging stations are not yet everywhere, and the batteries must eventually be recycled. Governments and companies are working together to build more stations and to develop better recycling methods. Which problem of electric cars is mentioned in the passage?（2分）
A．They are too slow.
B．Charging stations are not everywhere.
C．They use too much oil.
D．They are too noisy.
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 B。Which problem of electric cars is mentioned in the passage?

[阅读C] Honey has been used as food and medicine for thousands of years. Ancient Egyptians put it in tombs, and it was still edible after 3,000 years. Honey contains very little water and is acidic, so bacteria cannot easily grow in it. This is why it does not spoil quickly. Today, doctors still use special honey to help heal some wounds. Why does honey not spoil quickly?（2分）
A．It is kept in tombs.
B．It contains little water and is acidic.
C．It is always frozen.
D．It is mixed with salt.
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 C。Why does honey not spoil quickly?

What do teachers suggest to language learners?（2分）
A．To avoid speaking until perfect.
B．To start with simple sentences and speak daily.
C．To stop making mistakes.
D．To learn only grammar rules.

question: 阅读下面的短文，完成下列各题。（15小题，共22.5分） Last summer I 1 (1)______ a small village with my classmates. We stayed there for a week and helped the farmers 2 (2)______ vegetables. On the first day, I was 3 (3)______ because I had never worked on a farm before. An old man 4 (4)______ me how to pick tomatoes without hurting the plants. By the end of the week, I had learned a lot 5 (5)______ farming. More importantly, I learned that 6 (6)______ work can also be joyful. 1．A．visited B．built C．sold D．closed 2．A．eat B．cook C．pick D．buy 3．A．excited B．nervous C．angry D．bored 4．A．asked B．told C．taught D．warned 5．A．about B．for C．with D．by 6．A．easy B．hard C．short D．boring
explanation: 【解析】1. visited（「我」和同学去村子，此处为参观访问）；2. pick（帮农民「摘」菜）；3. nervous（此前从未在农场干过活，因此紧张）；4. taught（老人「教」我如何摘番茄）；5. about（learn about「了解关于……的知识」）；6. hard（下文「也能充满欢乐」，与「辛苦」形成转折）。

chapter: 第四部分　语法填空（共10小题，每小题1.5分，满分15分）
question: 阅读下面的短文，在空白处填入适当的内容。 Reading is one of the 1 (good) ______ habits a student can have. It 2 (help) ______ us learn new words and ideas. When I was young, my mother 3 (read) ______ stories to me every night. Now I read by 4 (I) ______. Books are 5 (friend) ______ that never leave us.
explanation: 【解析】1. 「one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词」，故 good→best；2. 主语 It 为第三人称单数，一般现在时，help→helps；3. 由 every night 与 Now 对比可知为一般过去时，read→read；4. by oneself 固定搭配，I→myself；5. friend 为可数名词，此处指一类事物，用复数 friends。

subject: 英语
chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 假设你是李华，你的英国朋友 Peter 即将到你校交流。请给他写一封邮件，内容包括：①表示欢迎；②介绍学校的基本情况；③说明你将如何帮助他适应新环境。 注意：①词数100左右；②可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。（15分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Dear Peter,
　　I am glad to hear that you will come to our school. Welcome!
　　Our school is not very large but beautiful. There are about 40 teachers and 600 students. We have a library, a playground and several science labs. Students here are friendly and hard-working.
　　When you arrive, I will show you around the school and introduce you to my classmates. I will also help you with Chinese if you need it. Please tell me what you are interested in, so that I can make better plans for your stay.
　　Looking forward to seeing you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①涵盖三个要点（欢迎、介绍学校、帮助适应）；②语言准确、连贯；③词数100左右；④格式正确（称呼、正文、落款）。

chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 阅读下面的材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一个完整的故事。 Tom was a shy boy who seldom spoke in class. One day, his teacher asked him to give a short speech in front of the whole class. His heart raced. He wanted to run away. Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. ______ Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. ______ 注意：①续写词数应为150左右；②请按如下格式作答。（25分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. "Courage is not the absence of fear," his father had said. "It is doing what you must do even when you are afraid." Tom took a deep breath and looked up at his classmates. He began to speak, slowly at first, and then more confidently.
Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. Then someone clapped, and soon the whole class was applauding. Tom could hardly believe it. From that day on, he was no longer afraid to speak in front of others. He had learned that the hardest step is always the first one.
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①两段内容合理衔接原文；②情节自然、符合逻辑；③语言丰富、句式多样；④有细节描写；⑤字数150左右。

[阅读A] Zhang Wei is a volunteer teacher in a mountain village. Every morning he walks forty minutes to school along a narrow path. "At first I wanted to leave," he says. "The weather was cold, and there was no internet. But the children's eyes kept me there." In three years, he has helped twelve students enter senior high school. He has also started a small library with books donated by people in the city. "I did not change the world," he says with a smile. "But maybe I changed twelve worlds." Zhang Wei decided to stay mainly because of ______.（2分）
A．the high salary
B．the children's eyes
C．the good weather
D．the internet
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 A。Zhang Wei decided to stay mainly because of ______. 对应原文信息点。

In many Chinese cities, shared bicycles have become popular in the last ten years. People can find a bicycle with a phone app, ride it, and leave it almost anywhere. However, the system has problems. Some bicycles are broken or parked badly, blocking the pavement. Cities are now working on better rules. What problem with shared bicycles is mentioned?（2分）
A．They are too expensive.
B．They produce much pollution.
C．Some are broken or parked badly.
D．They cannot be found by phone.

Through this network, a tree that has enough sugar can send some to a weaker neighbour. When one tree is attacked by insects, others can prepare their defences. This discovery has changed how we see forests. A forest is not just many trees; it is a community. According to the passage, the fungi network helps trees ______.（2分）
A．grow taller than others
B．share food and send warnings
C．produce more seeds
D．stay away from each other
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 C。According to the passage, the fungi network helps trees ______.

[阅读A] When Li Hua first entered senior high school, he felt lost. The courses were harder, the teachers spoke faster, and he had few friends. For two weeks he sat alone in the canteen, eating quickly and returning to the classroom. Everything changed on a rainy afternoon. He forgot his umbrella, and a girl named Wang Fang shared hers with him. They walked together and talked about their favourite books. By the time they reached the school gate, Li Hua had made his first friend. "It is not the big things that make you feel at home," Li Hua later wrote in his diary. "It is an umbrella, a smile, or simply someone who waits for you." Li Hua felt lost at first because ______.（2分）

B．the courses were harder and he had few friends
C．he disliked his teachers
D．he missed his primary school

[阅读B] A new study from a Chinese university suggests that students who sleep less than seven hours a night perform worse in memory tests than those who sleep eight hours. The researchers tested 1,200 students over three years. The finding is not surprising to doctors. During deep sleep, the brain organizes what we have learned during the day. Without enough sleep, this process is interrupted. The study also found that students who used phones before bed took longer to fall asleep. The light from screens tells the brain that it is still daytime. According to the passage, deep sleep helps students ______.（2分）
A．grow taller
B．organize what they have learned
C．use phones less
D．eat more healthily

Local volunteers have built a small station to watch and protect the birds. They record the number of each species and check whether the water is clean. "Birds are like visitors," said one volunteer. "If they keep coming back, it means we are doing something right." The volunteers' main purpose is to ______.（2分）
A．catch birds for study
B．watch and protect the birds
C．build houses for people
D．grow more plants

Supporters say it helps students take responsibility for their own progress. Critics argue that young students may delay their work without a fixed schedule. Most teachers agree that the answer lies in balance: some structure, plus some freedom. What is the main idea of the passage?（2分）
A．Schools should have more bells.
B．Self-paced learning has both benefits and risks.
C．Students should never choose tasks.
D．Teachers dislike all new methods.
explanation: 【解析】出处：短文 D。What is the main idea of the passage?

question: 阅读下面的短文，从A—G中选出能填入空白处的最佳选项。 How to Make a Good Study Plan A good study plan helps you use your time well. Here are some tips. First, write down all your tasks for the week. ______ Second, put the most difficult task first. ______ Third, take short breaks. ______ For example, study for 45 minutes, then rest for 10. Finally, check your plan every evening. ______ With a good plan, you will feel calmer and learn more.
explanation: 【解析】1. G（承上，说明列出任务的作用）；2. A（说明为何把最难的任务放前面）；3. B（引出「不要一次做完」并说明要短休）；4. C（说明每晚检查计划的内容）。

question: 阅读下面的短文，完成下列各题。（15小题，共22.5分） Last summer I 1 (1)______ a small village with my classmates. We stayed there for a week and helped the farmers 2 (2)______ vegetables. On the first day, I was 3 (3)______ because I had never worked on a farm before. An old man 4 (4)______ me how to pick tomatoes without hurting the plants. By the end of the week, I had learned a lot 5 (5)______ farming. More importantly, I learned that 6 (6)______ work can also be joyful. 1．A．visited B．built C．sold D．closed 2．A．eat B．cook C．pick D．buy 3．A．excited B．nervous C．angry D．bored 4．A．asked B．told C．taught D．warned 5．A．about B．for C．with D．by 6．A．easy B．hard C．short D．boring
explanation: 【解析】1. visited（「我」和同学去村子，此处为参观访问）；2. pick（帮农民「摘」菜）；3. nervous（此前从未在农场干过活，因此紧张）；4. taught（老人「教」我如何摘番茄）；5. about（learn about「了解关于……的知识」）；6. hard（下文「也能充满欢乐」，与「辛苦」形成转折）。

question: 阅读下面的短文，在空白处填入适当的内容。 Reading is one of the 1 (good) ______ habits a student can have. It 2 (help) ______ us learn new words and ideas. When I was young, my mother 3 (read) ______ stories to me every night. Now I read by 4 (I) ______. Books are 5 (friend) ______ that never leave us.
explanation: 【解析】1. 「one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词」，故 good→best；2. 主语 It 为第三人称单数，一般现在时，help→helps；3. 由 every night 与 Now 对比可知为一般过去时，read→read；4. by oneself 固定搭配，I→myself；5. friend 为可数名词，此处指一类事物，用复数 friends。

chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 假设你是李华，你的英国朋友 Peter 即将到你校交流。请给他写一封邮件，内容包括：①表示欢迎；②介绍学校的基本情况；③说明你将如何帮助他适应新环境。 注意：①词数100左右；②可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。（15分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Dear Peter,
　　I am glad to hear that you will come to our school. Welcome!
　　Our school is not very large but beautiful. There are about 40 teachers and 600 students. We have a library, a playground and several science labs. Students here are friendly and hard-working.
　　When you arrive, I will show you around the school and introduce you to my classmates. I will also help you with Chinese if you need it. Please tell me what you are interested in, so that I can make better plans for your stay.
　　Looking forward to seeing you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①涵盖三个要点（欢迎、介绍学校、帮助适应）；②语言准确、连贯；③词数100左右；④格式正确（称呼、正文、落款）。

question: 阅读下面的材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一个完整的故事。 Tom was a shy boy who seldom spoke in class. One day, his teacher asked him to give a short speech in front of the whole class. His heart raced. He wanted to run away. Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. ______ Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. ______ 注意：①续写词数应为150左右；②请按如下格式作答。（25分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. "Courage is not the absence of fear," his father had said. "It is doing what you must do even when you are afraid." Tom took a deep breath and looked up at his classmates. He began to speak, slowly at first, and then more confidently.
Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. Then someone clapped, and soon the whole class was applauding. Tom could hardly believe it. From that day on, he was no longer afraid to speak in front of others. He had learned that the hardest step is always the first one.
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①两段内容合理衔接原文；②情节自然、符合逻辑；③语言丰富、句式多样；④有细节描写；⑤字数150左右。

B．He gave up swimming.

question: 阅读下面的短文，在空白处填入适当的内容。 Reading is one of the 1 (good) ______ habits a student can have. It 2 (help) ______ us learn new words and ideas. When I was young, my mother 3 (read) ______ stories to me every night. Now I read by 4 (I) ______. Books are 5 (friend) ______ that never leave us.
explanation: 【解析】1. 「one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词」，故 good→best；2. 主语 It 为第三人称单数，一般现在时，help→helps；3. 由 every night 与 Now 对比可知为一般过去时，read→read；4. by oneself 固定搭配，I→myself；5. friend 为可数名词，此处指一类事物，用复数 friends。

chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 假设你是李华，你的英国朋友 Peter 即将到你校交流。请给他写一封邮件，内容包括：①表示欢迎；②介绍学校的基本情况；③说明你将如何帮助他适应新环境。 注意：①词数100左右；②可以适当增加细节，以使行文连贯。（15分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Dear Peter,
　　I am glad to hear that you will come to our school. Welcome!
　　Our school is not very large but beautiful. There are about 40 teachers and 600 students. We have a library, a playground and several science labs. Students here are friendly and hard-working.
　　When you arrive, I will show you around the school and introduce you to my classmates. I will also help you with Chinese if you need it. Please tell me what you are interested in, so that I can make better plans for your stay.
　　Looking forward to seeing you.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①涵盖三个要点（欢迎、介绍学校、帮助适应）；②语言准确、连贯；③词数100左右；④格式正确（称呼、正文、落款）。

chapter: 第五部分　书面表达（共2题，满分40分）
question: 阅读下面的材料，根据其内容和所给段落开头语续写两段，使之构成一个完整的故事。 Tom was a shy boy who seldom spoke in class. One day, his teacher asked him to give a short speech in front of the whole class. His heart raced. He wanted to run away. Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. ______ Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. ______ 注意：①续写词数应为150左右；②请按如下格式作答。（25分）
answer:
【参考范文】
Paragraph 1: But then he remembered what his father had told him. "Courage is not the absence of fear," his father had said. "It is doing what you must do even when you are afraid." Tom took a deep breath and looked up at his classmates. He began to speak, slowly at first, and then more confidently.
Paragraph 2: When he finished, the classroom was silent. Then someone clapped, and soon the whole class was applauding. Tom could hardly believe it. From that day on, he was no longer afraid to speak in front of others. He had learned that the hardest step is always the first one.
explanation: 【解析】评分要点：①两段内容合理衔接原文；②情节自然、符合逻辑；③语言丰富、句式多样；④有细节描写；⑤字数150左右。
